# UX design playbook: research, information architecture, accessibility, and iteration

Curated by Skill Harbor — @mindrally's UX design skill: a full-spectrum playbook for intuitive, accessible, user-centered interfaces — user interviews, personas and journey maps validated by usability testing and analytics; information architecture (logical organization, clear labeling, effective search, card sorting); interaction design (familiar components, clear CTAs, responsive design, thoughtful animation); visual design (hierarchy, cohesive palettes, strategic typography, WCAG 2.1 AA contrast); accessibility (semantic HTML, alt text, keyboard navigation, assistive-tech testing); performance (asset optimization, lazy loading, code splitting, Core Web Vitals); user feedback (loading indicators, clear errors, recovery paths); mobile-first design with touch targets and thumb zones; consistency via design systems; content strategy and progressive disclosure; and testing/iteration (A/B tests, heatmaps, session recordings, continuous feedback loops). Honest caveats: methodology only, no tooling — the agent needs a real interface to design or review; principles are stack-agnostic, not a Figma tutorial. Apache-2.0 licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
